Description: Verify API sends warning and sets warned_at for an overstaying session that has not been warned yet
PreRequisites: Execute SQL: INSERT INTO owners (name, email, subscription_active) VALUES ('Test Owner', 'test@owner.com', true) RETURNING id AS owner_id; INSERT INTO lots (owner_id, name, hourly_rate, wall_code) VALUES ((SELECT owner_id FROM owners ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1), 'Test Lot', 5.00, 'A123') RETURNING id AS lot_id; INSERT INTO spots (lot_id, code, is_active) VALUES ((SELECT lot_id FROM lots ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1), 'A1', true) RETURNING id AS spot_id; INSERT INTO drivers (name, email) VALUES ('Test Driver', 'test@driver.com') RETURNING id AS driver_id; INSERT INTO reservations (driver_id, lot_id, spot_id, start_time, end_time, status) VALUES ((SELECT driver_id FROM drivers ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1), (SELECT lot_id FROM lots ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1), (SELECT spot_id FROM spots ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1), NOW() - INTERVAL '3 hours', NOW() + INTERVAL '1 hour', 'active') RETURNING id AS reservation_id; INSERT INTO sessions (reservation_id, checkin_at, checkout_at, status) VALUES ((SELECT reservation_id FROM reservations ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1), NOW() - INTERVAL '2 hours', NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour', 'overstaying') RETURNING id AS session_id; UPDATE sessions SET warned_at = NULL WHERE id = (SELECT session_id FROM sessions ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1); Mock POST /notify to return HTTP 200 with JSON {}
ExpectedResult: HTTP 200 OK. JSON contains {'warned': true, 'already_warned': false}
Post-Assertions: Execute SQL: SELECT warned_at FROM sessions WHERE id = <dynamic_id> -> Expected: NOT NULL
